character: 160 km linking Valloire (Baroque church, authentic village) and Valmeinier (higher, quieter satellite). Good value.
name: Galibier-Thabor
description: 150km linked between Valloire and Valmeinier in the upper Maurienne valley. 35 lifts. Named after the Col du Galibier (2,642m) and Mont Thabor (3,202m). Known for: the Galibier pass (iconic Tour de France climb), the baroque church at Valloire, and reliable snow at altitude (the domain sits above 1,400m). Quiet, family-focused, and more affordable than northern Alps.

lift_pass_pricing.note: Local pass covers Valloire-Valmeinier linked area. Good value.

suitability.families: Good — Valloire is a traditional village with character. Valmeinier newer.
